0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-3, 10th in the West) host the Toronto Raptors (3-3, 7th in the East) with both teams a game under .500 after six games, Denver coming off a loss and Toronto on a two-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won their two meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Toronto is without Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture).
